settings.hero_desc: Fun, characterful golf trophies - a cheering golf-ball character and a ball-on-tee design - on bases with engraved plaques. The perfect lighthearted awards for "Longest Drive", "Most Golf" and other golf-day categories.
settings.s1_body: Bring some personality to your golf event. These novelty trophies - a celebrating golf-ball character with arms raised, and a classic ball-on-tee design - are fun, photogenic and personalised with the category and winner. Ideal for corporate golf days, society events and tournaments, with matching designs for every award you hand out.
settings.case_heading: The Hit of the Golf Day
settings.case_body: Created for a corporate golf event, these novelty trophies made the prize-giving genuinely fun - personalised per category and proudly carried home by every winner.
settings.case_quote: Everyone loved them - way more fun than a standard cup. Perfect for our golf day.
settings.prov_p: A golf day is meant to be enjoyed - so why not the trophies? Playful, characterful awards make the prize-giving as memorable as the round itself.
